cell_type_or_model: contusive SCI tissue and primary spinal astrocytes
assay_or_perturbation: thrombin stimulation; PAR1 antagonist/agonist; MAPK/NF-κB phosphorylation and astrocyte morphology/inflammatory assays
evidence_summary: Thrombin activated PAR1-associated MAPK/NF-κB signaling and inflammatory astrocyte responses after SCI.
limitations: No single terminal TF target gene was established; PAR1 branch is receptor-specific but terminal output remains composite.

assay_or_perturbation: resistin/TLR4 blockade or stimulation; MyD88/MAPK/NF-κB and cytokine assays
evidence_summary: Resistin was associated with TLR4/MD2/CD14-dependent MyD88/MAPK/NF-κB inflammatory signaling.
limitations: 20B LR status remains boundary/non-exportable and the receiver-cell context is not SCI-specific.

cell_type_or_model: spinal cord neural stem cells after SCI
assay_or_perturbation: C3a/C3aR blockade; NF-κB p65 knockdown; Nrf2 overexpression; ChIP/promoter and UCHL1/proteasome assays
evidence_summary: C3a/C3aR signaling activated NF-κB p65, suppressed Nrf2 and UCHL1, and impaired spinal NSC activation; UCHL1 was identified as a direct Nrf2 target.
limitations: The 20B row is a boundary candidate and the direct target is Nrf2→UCHL1, not C3aR1→UCHL1.
